race.comment: PINAZAKI (5) shows plenty of pace in his races, and that will serve him well on this course. He was only claimed late at Traralgon last start when finishing runner-up by a short head, and with the blinkers off for the first time, he may take them all the way. ALL EYES ON ERIN (7) rattled home fresh up for second at Ballarat, then was looking for more ground at Kilmore last time out. John Allen returns to the saddle, and she can bounce straight back into the money over a more suitable trip here. MOVE IT (4) was well in the market on debut when weakening to finish out of the money after travelling handy throughout. He has the pole position here and is worth another chance. FLARE OF GRACE (10) hit the line strongly for third on debut over 1200m, and the extra 150m will make all the difference this time. Stick with her.
